name: COALESCE
description: Returns the first non-NULL argument; later arguments are not evaluated after a value is found. At least two arguments are required.

name: IFNULL
description: Returns fallback only when value is NULL, evaluating only the selected argument.

name: NULLIF
description: Returns NULL when a and b compare equal under the active comparison rules; otherwise returns a.

name: IIF
description: Evaluates the condition and only the selected branch. A NULL condition selects the false branch.

name: MIN
description: With two or more scalar arguments, returns the smallest or largest value using active comparison rules. Any NULL argument makes the result NULL. One argument selects the grouped aggregate form.

name: MAX
description: With two or more scalar arguments, returns the smallest or largest value using active comparison rules. Any NULL argument makes the result NULL. One argument selects the grouped aggregate form.

name: LENGTH
description: Counts Unicode code points in TEXT and bytes in BLOB. NULL returns NULL.
notes: MySQL mode overrides LENGTH to count bytes; PostgreSQL uses its own text/bytea implementation.

name: UPPER
description: Changes letter case using Unicode-aware string conversion. NULL returns NULL.

name: LOWER
description: Changes letter case using Unicode-aware string conversion. NULL returns NULL.

name: SUBSTR
description: Slices TEXT by Unicode code point or BLOB by byte. Positions are one-based; negative starts count from the end. A negative length selects characters preceding the start.
notes: Start zero reduces a positive requested length by one. PostgreSQL overrides negative-position/negative-length behavior.

name: REPLACE
description: Replaces every literal occurrence. An empty search leaves the input unchanged; any NULL argument returns NULL.

name: TRIM
description: Removes a set of characters from both ends, the left end, or the right end, respectively. The default character set is a space. NULL input or trim set returns NULL.
notes: SQL TRIM([BOTH | LEADING | TRAILING] substring FROM text) is also parsed; that syntax removes repeated whole substrings.

name: LTRIM
description: Removes a set of characters from both ends, the left end, or the right end, respectively. The default character set is a space. NULL input or trim set returns NULL.
notes: SQL TRIM([BOTH | LEADING | TRAILING] substring FROM text) is also parsed; that syntax removes repeated whole substrings.

name: RTRIM
description: Removes a set of characters from both ends, the left end, or the right end, respectively. The default character set is a space. NULL input or trim set returns NULL.
notes: SQL TRIM([BOTH | LEADING | TRAILING] substring FROM text) is also parsed; that syntax removes repeated whole substrings.

name: INSTR
description: Returns the one-based first match or zero when absent. Two BLOBs use byte positions; otherwise positions count Unicode code points. NULL propagates.

name: HEX
description: Returns uppercase hexadecimal input bytes. Numeric inputs are encoded from their text representation. Native NULL produces an empty string; MySQL-mode NULL remains NULL.
notes: Numeric inputs currently retain native textual-byte conversion in MySQL mode too; this is not complete MySQL numeric HEX equivalence.

name: QUOTE
description: Formats a value as a SQL literal, including SQL NULL and escaped string quoting.

name: TYPEOF
description: Returns a native diagnostic type label: null, integer, real, blob, or text. Other native value kinds currently fall through to text.
notes: This is a diagnostic label, not a complete declaration or PostgreSQL type-name lookup.

name: ABS
description: Returns absolute numeric value, preserving integer or exact numeric representation where supported. NULL propagates; nonnumeric input and signed integer overflow fail.
notes: MySQL and PostgreSQL sessions provide their own coercion and metadata rules.

name: ROUND
description: Rounds a numeric value; digits defaults to zero. Native digits are clamped to 0 through 30. Integer/real inputs use floating-point rounding; exact DECIMAL inputs retain decimal arithmetic.
notes: MySQL supports negative digit counts and different exact/approximate tie rules. PostgreSQL uses a separate numeric implementation.

name: RANDOM
description: Returns a nonnegative pseudo-random signed 64-bit integer. It is not a cryptographic random-byte generator.
notes: PostgreSQL mode retains this native integer behavior; use RAND for a MySQL-style real result.

name: CAST
description: Converts to a supported SQL type with the active dialect’s conversion, precision, range, and length checks. NULL remains NULL.
notes: Use SQL AS syntax, not CAST(value, type). PostgreSQL also supports :: casts. See SQL semantics and the protocol guides for type coverage.

name: DATE
description: Formats a parsed value as YYYY-MM-DD, HH:MM:SS, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. No argument, an empty string, or now reads the current UTC clock.
notes: Numeric input is a Julian day, not Unix seconds. Invalid or NULL timestrings fail. These are native helpers, not complete SQLite/MySQL temporal emulations.

name: TIME
description: Formats a parsed value as YYYY-MM-DD, HH:MM:SS, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. No argument, an empty string, or now reads the current UTC clock.
notes: Numeric input is a Julian day, not Unix seconds. Invalid or NULL timestrings fail. These are native helpers, not complete SQLite/MySQL temporal emulations.

name: DATETIME
description: Formats a parsed value as YYYY-MM-DD, HH:MM:SS, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. No argument, an empty string, or now reads the current UTC clock.
notes: Numeric input is a Julian day, not Unix seconds. Invalid or NULL timestrings fail. These are native helpers, not complete SQLite/MySQL temporal emulations.

name: JULIANDAY
description: Returns the Julian-day number for the parsed time, with the same inputs and modifiers as native DATE.

name: STRFTIME
description: Formats a native time with %Y, %m, %d, %H, %M, %S, %w, %j, %s, and %f. Here %f is a three-digit millisecond field, not SQLite’s seconds-plus-fraction field.
notes: Unknown percent escapes emit the following character. Supported modifiers are described above the entries.

name: CHANGES
description: Currently returns the integer 0. This native compatibility placeholder does not expose actual affected-row counts or the generated row ID.
notes: Use Go ExecResult.Changes/LastID or MySQL ROW_COUNT()/LAST_INSERT_ID() for actual execution information.

name: LAST_INSERT_ROWID
description: Currently returns the integer 0. This native compatibility placeholder does not expose actual affected-row counts or the generated row ID.
notes: Use Go ExecResult.Changes/LastID or MySQL ROW_COUNT()/LAST_INSERT_ID() for actual execution information.

name: JSON
description: Validates and canonicalizes a JSON document. Both names use the native JSON representation; JSONB does not introduce a separate PostgreSQL binary storage engine.

name: JSONB
description: Validates and canonicalizes a JSON document. Both names use the native JSON representation; JSONB does not introduce a separate PostgreSQL binary storage engine.

name: JSON_VALID
description: Returns 1 for valid JSON, 0 for invalid JSON, or SQL NULL for SQL NULL.

name: JSON_ARRAY
description: Builds an array. SQL NULL becomes JSON null. JSON-typed arguments embed as JSON; ordinary text arguments become JSON strings.

name: JSON_OBJECT
description: Builds an object from key/value pairs. An odd argument count or NULL key fails. Later duplicate keys overwrite earlier ones.

name: JSON_TYPE
description: Returns OBJECT, ARRAY, STRING, INTEGER, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, or NULL as a text label. SQL NULL remains SQL NULL.

name: JSON_QUOTE
description: Quotes and escapes text as a JSON string. SQL NULL remains NULL.

name: JSON_UNQUOTE
description: Decodes a quoted JSON string; other text is returned unchanged. Malformed quoted strings fail.

name: JSON_PRETTY
description: Returns JSON indented with two spaces.

name: JSON_DEPTH
description: Returns maximum nesting depth, counting the root as one.

name: JSON_LENGTH
description: Returns the number of members/elements at the root or selected path; a scalar has length one. An absent path returns NULL.

name: JSON_KEYS
description: Returns an array of sorted object keys. A non-object or missing target returns NULL.

name: JSON_STORAGE_SIZE
description: Returns the byte length of canonical serialized JSON, not the physical on-disk LSM space used by the row.

name: JSON_STORAGE_FREE
description: Validates the document and returns 0; the engine does not expose an in-place JSON free-space allocator.

name: JSON_EXTRACT
description: Returns matching JSON or SQL NULL when no path matches. Multiple paths or wildcards produce an array of collected matches.

name: JSON_VALUE
description: Returns the first matched scalar as TEXT; numbers and booleans are textual too. Missing values, JSON null, arrays, and objects return SQL NULL.

name: JSON_CONTAINS
description: Tests JSON containment at the root or selected path. The candidate is itself a JSON document.

name: JSON_CONTAINS_PATH
description: Tests whether any path (one) or every path (all) exists.

name: JSON_OVERLAPS
description: Tests for a shared array element, shared object key/value pair, or compatible scalar value.

name: JSON_SET
description: Adds absent targets and replaces existing targets. Arguments after the document must be path/value pairs, applied in order.
notes: Modifying paths reject wildcards. SQL text values become JSON strings unless explicitly converted to JSON.

name: JSON_INSERT
description: Adds targets that are absent; existing values are kept. Arguments after the document must be path/value pairs, applied in order.
notes: Modifying paths reject wildcards. SQL text values become JSON strings unless explicitly converted to JSON.

name: JSON_REPLACE
description: Replaces existing targets; absent targets are kept absent. Arguments after the document must be path/value pairs, applied in order.
notes: Modifying paths reject wildcards. SQL text values become JSON strings unless explicitly converted to JSON.

name: JSON_ARRAY_APPEND
description: Appends to the selected array, wrapping a selected scalar as an array where supported. Arguments after the document must be path/value pairs, applied in order.
notes: Modifying paths reject wildcards. SQL text values become JSON strings unless explicitly converted to JSON.

name: JSON_ARRAY_INSERT
description: Inserts before a selected array index. Arguments after the document must be path/value pairs, applied in order.
notes: Modifying paths reject wildcards. SQL text values become JSON strings unless explicitly converted to JSON.

name: JSON_REMOVE
description: Removes targets in sequence and returns the resulting JSON.

name: JSON_MERGE_PATCH
description: Applies merge-patch semantics. Object members with JSON null remove that key; a non-object patch replaces its target.

name: JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE
description: Merges objects and arrays while preserving colliding values in arrays. JSON_MERGE is an alias of JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE.

name: JSON_MERGE
description: Merges objects and arrays while preserving colliding values in arrays. JSON_MERGE is an alias of JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE.

name: IF
description: Evaluates only the chosen branch. NULL or a false condition selects when_false.

name: GREATEST
description: Returns the greatest or least argument. Any NULL returns NULL. All-numeric inputs use numeric comparison; mixed inputs use their string forms.

name: LEAST
description: Returns the greatest or least argument. Any NULL returns NULL. All-numeric inputs use numeric comparison; mixed inputs use their string forms.

name: ISNULL
description: Returns 1 for SQL NULL and 0 otherwise.

name: CONCAT
description: Concatenates values; any NULL argument returns NULL. A BLOB argument makes the result binary.
notes: PostgreSQL CONCAT skips NULL arguments instead.

name: CONCAT_WS
description: Concatenates non-NULL values with a separator. A NULL separator returns NULL; NULL values are skipped.

name: LEFT
description: Returns the requested number of characters from the left or right. TEXT counts code points and BLOB counts bytes; a nonpositive count returns an empty value.

name: RIGHT
description: Returns the requested number of characters from the left or right. TEXT counts code points and BLOB counts bytes; a nonpositive count returns an empty value.

name: SUBSTRING
description: Returns a one-based slice; negative positions count from the end. Zero, out-of-range positions, or nonpositive lengths produce an empty value.
notes: Also supports SUBSTRING(value FROM start FOR length). Unlike native SUBSTR, negative length does not select preceding characters.

name: MID
description: Returns a one-based slice; negative positions count from the end. Zero, out-of-range positions, or nonpositive lengths produce an empty value.
notes: Also supports SUBSTRING(value FROM start FOR length). Unlike native SUBSTR, negative length does not select preceding characters.

name: LPAD
description: Pads to a character/byte length or truncates longer input. Zero returns empty; negative length returns NULL. An empty pad returns empty when extension would be needed.

name: RPAD
description: Pads to a character/byte length or truncates longer input. Zero returns empty; negative length returns NULL. An empty pad returns empty when extension would be needed.

name: REPEAT
description: Repeats a value; nonpositive count returns empty. Expanded results are checked against the query memory budget.

name: REVERSE
description: Reverses Unicode code points for TEXT or bytes for BLOB.

name: SPACE
description: Returns count spaces; a nonpositive count returns an empty string.

name: INSERT
description: Replaces a span at a one-based position. An invalid position leaves the original unchanged; a negative length replaces through the end.

name: SUBSTRING_INDEX
description: Returns the portion before count delimiter occurrences for positive count, or after that many occurrences from the right for negative count. Matching is literal.

name: LOCATE
description: Returns a one-based match position from optional start, or zero if absent. Text positions count characters; binary positions count bytes.

name: POSITION
description: SQL POSITION syntax for a first-match location, or zero when absent.

name: STRCMP
description: Returns -1, 0, or 1 from active collation-aware string comparison. NULL propagates.

name: FIELD
description: Returns the one-based index of the first matching candidate, or zero. NULL search values do not match NULL candidates.

name: FIND_IN_SET
description: Returns the one-based position in a comma-separated list, or zero if absent. NULL propagates.

name: ELT
description: Returns the one-based selected value or NULL for an invalid index.

name: MAKE_SET
description: Builds a comma-separated list of non-NULL values selected by bits, beginning with the low bit.

name: EXPORT_SET
description: Formats each selected bit as on or off, low bit first. Separator defaults to comma; bit count defaults to 64 and is capped at 64.

name: SOUNDEX
description: Returns the implemented Soundex phonetic code; this is not a locale-aware fuzzy matching engine.

name: LCASE
description: Aliases for lowercasing and uppercasing Unicode text, respectively; binary input retains binary result metadata.
notes: BLOB input is returned unchanged with binary result metadata.

name: UCASE
description: Aliases for lowercasing and uppercasing Unicode text, respectively; binary input retains binary result metadata.
notes: BLOB input is returned unchanged with binary result metadata.

name: ASCII
description: Returns the first byte value or zero for empty input. NULL stays NULL.

name: ORD
description: Combines the first character’s UTF-8 bytes into an integer; BLOB input uses its first byte. Empty input returns zero.

name: CHAR
description: Builds bytes from integer codes, skipping NULL codes. The USING UTF-8 form returns validated TEXT instead of the default binary result.

name: CHAR_LENGTH
description: Counts Unicode code points in TEXT or bytes in BLOB. These names are aliases.

name: CHARACTER_LENGTH
description: Counts Unicode code points in TEXT or bytes in BLOB. These names are aliases.

name: OCTET_LENGTH
description: Counts bytes, including the UTF-8 bytes of TEXT.

name: BIT_LENGTH
description: Returns eight times the input byte length.

name: UNHEX
description: Decodes hexadecimal text to bytes. Odd-length strings are left-padded with zero; invalid hex returns NULL.

name: TO_BASE64
description: Encodes bytes as Base64, inserting a line break after each 76 output characters.

name: FROM_BASE64
description: Decodes Base64, ignoring supported whitespace; invalid encoded data returns NULL.

name: CHARSET
description: Reports the expression charset or collation label. Text defaults to utf8mb4/utf8mb4_bin; binary and nontext values report binary.

name: COLLATION
description: Reports the expression charset or collation label. Text defaults to utf8mb4/utf8mb4_bin; binary and nontext values report binary.

name: REGEXP_LIKE
description: Returns 1 when a RE2 pattern matches, 0 otherwise. Match flags include case and multiline controls; NULL propagates.

name: REGEXP_INSTR
signature: REGEXP_INSTR(value, pattern [, position [, occurrence [, return_option [, match_type]]]])
description: Returns a one-based match start (return_option 0) or position after the match (1), or zero if no match. Positions count Unicode characters.

name: REGEXP_SUBSTR
description: Returns the selected match or NULL when absent.

name: REGEXP_REPLACE
signature: REGEXP_REPLACE(value, pattern, replacement [, position [, occurrence [, match_type]]])
description: Replaces matching substrings. Occurrence zero replaces all; positive occurrence replaces only that match. Capture references in replacement are supported.
notes: Regex uses RE2, not ICU: lookarounds and pattern backreferences are rejected. Some noninitial-position anchored matches are also rejected.

name: ABS
description: Returns absolute value using MySQL numeric-prefix coercion and exact-number handling. Signed minimum BIGINT overflow fails.

name: ROUND
description: Rounds at a decimal position, including negative positions. Exact integer/DECIMAL ties round away from zero; approximate DOUBLE ties use nearest-even.

name: TRUNCATE
description: Truncates decimal places toward zero. Negative digits remove integer digits to the left of the decimal point.

name: CEIL
description: Rounds toward positive infinity for CEIL/CEILING, or negative infinity for FLOOR. Exact integer/DECIMAL inputs retain exact computation.

name: CEILING
description: Rounds toward positive infinity for CEIL/CEILING, or negative infinity for FLOOR. Exact integer/DECIMAL inputs retain exact computation.

name: FLOOR
description: Rounds toward positive infinity for CEIL/CEILING, or negative infinity for FLOOR. Exact integer/DECIMAL inputs retain exact computation.

name: SIGN
description: Returns -1, 0, or 1 according to the numeric sign. NULL propagates.

name: MOD
description: Returns the remainder using exact arithmetic when possible. A zero divisor returns NULL; floating inputs use real arithmetic.

name: PI
description: Returns the double-precision value of pi.

name: POW
description: Raises base to exponent with double-precision math. Invalid real domains return NULL; overflowing results fail.

name: POWER
description: Raises base to exponent with double-precision math. Invalid real domains return NULL; overflowing results fail.

name: SQRT
description: Square root. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: EXP
description: Base-e exponential. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: LN
description: Natural logarithm. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: LOG2
description: Base-2 logarithm. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: LOG10
description: Base-10 logarithm. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: SIN
description: Sine of a radian angle. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: COS
description: Cosine of a radian angle. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: TAN
description: Tangent of a radian angle. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: ASIN
description: Inverse sine in radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: ACOS
description: Inverse cosine in radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: COT
description: Cotangent of a radian angle. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: DEGREES
description: Converts radians to degrees. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: RADIANS
description: Converts degrees to radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates, invalid real domains return NULL, and nonfinite overflow fails.

name: LOG
description: One argument computes the natural logarithm; two arguments choose the base. Invalid bases or domains return NULL.
notes: PostgreSQL LOG(value) uses base 10.

name: ATAN
description: Returns inverse tangent in radians, with optional two-argument quadrant selection.

name: ATAN2
description: Returns the quadrant-aware inverse tangent in radians.

name: RAND
description: Returns a pseudo-random REAL. A constant seed initializes statement-local sequences; column-dependent seeds reseed per row. Prepared executions start a fresh seeded sequence.
notes: RAND is volatile even with a seed. It is not a cryptographic random generator.

name: CONV
description: Converts a numeric string between bases 2 through 36; signed destination bases select signed interpretation.

name: BIN
description: Returns unsigned integer digits in base 2 (BIN) or base 8 (OCT).

name: OCT
description: Returns unsigned integer digits in base 2 (BIN) or base 8 (OCT).

name: BIT_COUNT
description: Counts set bits in an integer or all bytes of a BLOB.

name: CRC32
description: Returns the unsigned IEEE CRC-32 checksum of the input bytes.

name: FORMAT
description: Returns a rounded, grouped numeric string using the supported locale’s punctuation. Default locale is en_US.
notes: This is numeric formatting; PostgreSQL FORMAT interprets a formatting template instead.

name: YEAR
description: Year number. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: MONTH
description: Month number 1 through 12. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: DAY
description: Day of month. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: DAYOFMONTH
description: Day of month. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: DAYOFWEEK
description: Weekday with Sunday=1 through Saturday=7. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: DAYOFYEAR
description: One-based day of year. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: WEEKDAY
description: Weekday with Monday=0 through Sunday=6. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: QUARTER
description: Quarter number 1 through 4. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: DAYNAME
description: English weekday name. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: MONTHNAME
description: English month name. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: LAST_DAY
description: Last calendar date of the input month. Uses the MySQL-style civil-date parser; invalid inputs can return NULL.

name: WEEK
description: Returns a week number or combined year/week number under one of the eight MySQL week modes. WEEK defaults to mode 0; YEARWEEK also defaults to mode 0.

name: YEARWEEK
description: Returns a week number or combined year/week number under one of the eight MySQL week modes. WEEK defaults to mode 0; YEARWEEK also defaults to mode 0.

name: WEEKOFYEAR
description: Returns the ISO-style week number, equivalent to WEEK(date, 3).

name: HOUR
description: Returns the absolute hour component, including supported multi-day durations; the sign is not included in the HOUR result.

name: MINUTE
description: Minute component. The implementation supports signed MySQL time durations up to 838 hours.

name: SECOND
description: Second component. The implementation supports signed MySQL time durations up to 838 hours.

name: MICROSECOND
description: Fractional microseconds. The implementation supports signed MySQL time durations up to 838 hours.

name: TIME_TO_SEC
description: Returns signed elapsed whole seconds. Fractional microseconds are truncated toward zero by the current implementation.

name: SEC_TO_TIME
description: Converts signed seconds to a time string within the supported MySQL duration range.

name: ADDTIME
description: Adds or subtracts a time duration; date-time input retains a date-time result.

name: SUBTIME
description: Adds or subtracts a time duration; date-time input retains a date-time result.

name: TIMEDIFF
description: Returns the signed time difference a minus b for compatible time/date-time inputs.

name: DATEDIFF
description: Returns the calendar-day difference a minus b, ignoring clock parts.

name: MAKETIME
description: Builds a signed time value, including fractional seconds, subject to duration limits.

name: MAKEDATE
description: Builds a date from a year and one-based day count. Nonpositive day counts return NULL.

name: TO_DAYS
description: Returns the MySQL calendar day number or the corresponding seconds count, not Unix epoch time.

name: TO_SECONDS
description: Returns the MySQL calendar day number or the corresponding seconds count, not Unix epoch time.

name: FROM_DAYS
description: Converts a MySQL day number to a date. Values outside the implemented calendar range return the zero-date text 0000-00-00.

name: PERIOD_ADD
description: Adds months to a YYMM or YYYYMM period and returns a YYYYMM integer.

name: PERIOD_DIFF
description: Returns the month difference between YYMM or YYYYMM periods.

name: DATE_ADD
description: Adds or subtracts a calendar/time interval, clamping month-end dates. ADDDATE/SUBDATE also accept a two-argument day count.
notes: Supported simple and compound interval units are parsed by the engine. This does not provide unrestricted interval SQL semantics.

name: DATE_SUB
description: Adds or subtracts a calendar/time interval, clamping month-end dates. ADDDATE/SUBDATE also accept a two-argument day count.
notes: Supported simple and compound interval units are parsed by the engine. This does not provide unrestricted interval SQL semantics.

name: ADDDATE
description: Adds or subtracts a calendar/time interval, clamping month-end dates. ADDDATE/SUBDATE also accept a two-argument day count.
notes: Supported simple and compound interval units are parsed by the engine. This does not provide unrestricted interval SQL semantics.

name: SUBDATE
description: Adds or subtracts a calendar/time interval, clamping month-end dates. ADDDATE/SUBDATE also accept a two-argument day count.
notes: Supported simple and compound interval units are parsed by the engine. This does not provide unrestricted interval SQL semantics.

name: TIMESTAMPADD
description: Adds a specified interval unit to a date-time.

name: TIMESTAMPDIFF
description: Returns end minus start as an integer count of whole requested units.

name: EXTRACT
description: Extracts a component or supported compound component such as YEAR_MONTH.

name: DATE_FORMAT
description: Formats a date/time using the supported MySQL percent templates. Calendar names are English and the session timezone is UTC.

name: TIME_FORMAT
description: Formats a date/time using the supported MySQL percent templates. Calendar names are English and the session timezone is UTC.

name: STR_TO_DATE
description: Parses the implemented MySQL percent-template subset into temporal TEXT; invalid combinations return NULL.

name: FROM_UNIXTIME
description: Converts supported nonnegative Unix seconds to UTC date-time TEXT, or formats the result with a MySQL template.

name: UNIX_TIMESTAMP
description: Without input returns current Unix seconds. A parsed UTC input returns epoch seconds; fractional input can produce a REAL. Invalid date text returns zero.

name: CURDATE
description: Returns the statement’s current UTC date. These date forms accept no precision argument.

name: CURRENT_DATE
description: Returns the statement’s current UTC date. These date forms accept no precision argument.

name: UTC_DATE
description: Returns the statement’s current UTC date. These date forms accept no precision argument.

name: CURTIME
description: Returns the statement’s current UTC time. Optional fractional precision is 0 through 6.

name: CURRENT_TIME
description: Returns the statement’s current UTC time. Optional fractional precision is 0 through 6.

name: UTC_TIME
description: Returns the statement’s current UTC time. Optional fractional precision is 0 through 6.

name: NOW
description: Returns the statement’s UTC date and time; optional fractional precision is 0 through 6. Statement-time values are stable within one statement.
notes: PostgreSQL NOW and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP have transaction-clock semantics instead.

name: CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
description: Returns the statement’s UTC date and time; optional fractional precision is 0 through 6. Statement-time values are stable within one statement.
notes: PostgreSQL NOW and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP have transaction-clock semantics instead.

name: LOCALTIME
description: Returns the statement’s UTC date and time; optional fractional precision is 0 through 6. Statement-time values are stable within one statement.
notes: PostgreSQL NOW and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP have transaction-clock semantics instead.

name: LOCALTIMESTAMP
description: Returns the statement’s UTC date and time; optional fractional precision is 0 through 6. Statement-time values are stable within one statement.
notes: PostgreSQL NOW and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP have transaction-clock semantics instead.

name: UTC_TIMESTAMP
description: Returns the statement’s UTC date and time; optional fractional precision is 0 through 6. Statement-time values are stable within one statement.
notes: PostgreSQL NOW and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP have transaction-clock semantics instead.

name: SYSDATE
description: Reads the wall clock at evaluation time rather than the statement’s initial timestamp. Precision is 0 through 6.

name: MD5
description: Returns a lowercase hexadecimal digest. MD5 is MD5; SHA and SHA1 are SHA-1 aliases. NULL propagates.

name: SHA
description: Returns a lowercase hexadecimal digest. MD5 is MD5; SHA and SHA1 are SHA-1 aliases. NULL propagates.

name: SHA1
description: Returns a lowercase hexadecimal digest. MD5 is MD5; SHA and SHA1 are SHA-1 aliases. NULL propagates.

name: SHA2
description: Returns SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 as lowercase hex. Bits zero selects 256; unsupported sizes return NULL.

name: AES_ENCRYPT
description: Encrypts/decrypts with the implemented default aes-128-ecb key folding and block padding. The optional IV does not change ECB operation.
notes: Other block modes and KDF parameters are not implemented; malformed ciphertext or padding returns NULL.

name: AES_DECRYPT
description: Encrypts/decrypts with the implemented default aes-128-ecb key folding and block padding. The optional IV does not change ECB operation.
notes: Other block modes and KDF parameters are not implemented; malformed ciphertext or padding returns NULL.

name: RANDOM_BYTES
description: Returns cryptographically random bytes. Length must be from 1 through 1024.

name: COMPRESS
description: Returns the MySQL-compatible length-prefix/zlib representation of the input bytes.

name: UNCOMPRESS
description: Decodes a supported MySQL compressed value. Expansion is bounded by the query memory budget.

name: UNCOMPRESSED_LENGTH
description: Reads the declared uncompressed byte length from a compressed value’s prefix; a too-short input returns zero.

name: UUID
description: Generates a version-1-layout UUID with random node/clock-sequence components and returns its textual form.

name: IS_UUID
description: Returns 1 for an accepted UUID string and 0 for invalid text; SQL NULL remains NULL.

name: UUID_TO_BIN
description: Converts a UUID string to 16 bytes. A nonzero swap flag rearranges time fields; invalid UUID text fails.

name: BIN_TO_UUID
description: Converts exactly 16 bytes to UUID text, optionally reversing time-field swapping. Invalid binary length fails.

name: INET_ATON
description: Converts accepted dotted IPv4 text, including supported short forms, to an unsigned integer. Invalid addresses return NULL.

name: INET_NTOA
description: Converts an in-range IPv4 integer to dotted text; invalid values return NULL.

name: INET6_ATON
description: Parses IPv4/IPv6 into 4 or 16 bytes; invalid addresses or zone suffixes return NULL.

name: INET6_NTOA
description: Formats a valid 4- or 16-byte network address; invalid lengths return NULL.

name: IS_IPV4
description: Returns 1 for a valid address of the named family and 0 otherwise, including SQL NULL.

name: IS_IPV6
description: Returns 1 for a valid address of the named family and 0 otherwise, including SQL NULL.

name: IS_IPV4_COMPAT
description: Tests a 16-byte address for the IPv4-compatible or IPv4-mapped binary layout. Non-16-byte inputs and NULL return zero.

name: IS_IPV4_MAPPED
description: Tests a 16-byte address for the IPv4-compatible or IPv4-mapped binary layout. Non-16-byte inputs and NULL return zero.

name: USER
description: Returns the MySQL connection user identity. These names use the same connection callback; native calls without that context fail.

name: SESSION_USER
description: Returns the MySQL connection user identity. These names use the same connection callback; native calls without that context fail.

name: SYSTEM_USER
description: Returns the MySQL connection user identity. These names use the same connection callback; native calls without that context fail.

name: CURRENT_USER
description: Returns the authenticated MySQL connection identity. A MySQL connection is required.

name: DATABASE
description: Returns the current database/schema name. SCHEMA is an alias through the database session state.

name: SCHEMA
description: Returns the current database/schema name. SCHEMA is an alias through the database session state.

name: VERSION
description: Returns the MySQL protocol server’s advertised compatibility version, not a claim that the underlying engine is MySQL.

name: CONNECTION_ID
description: Returns the current MySQL protocol connection ID.

name: LAST_INSERT_ID
description: Returns the first generated ID from the connection’s preceding insert, or explicitly sets the connection value. Explicitly supplied row IDs do not replace it; state survives rollback.

name: ROW_COUNT
description: Reports affected rows for the preceding statement, or -1 after a result-producing statement.

name: FOUND_ROWS
description: Returns the preceding SELECT row count. With SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS, it reports qualifying rows before LIMIT/OFFSET, counted once at the statement snapshot; otherwise it reports returned rows.
notes: Connection-local state is updated after execution; use the same pinned connection when reading it.

name: GET_LOCK
description: Acquires a connection-scoped named lock. Returns 1 on success or 0 on timeout. Reacquisition by the same connection increments an acquisition count; cancellation interrupts waits.

name: RELEASE_LOCK
description: Releases one acquisition of a named lock. Returns 1 when released, 0 when held by another connection, or NULL when the lock does not exist.

name: IS_FREE_LOCK
description: Returns 1 when the named lock is unheld and 0 when it is held.

name: IS_USED_LOCK
description: Returns the owning connection ID, or NULL when the named lock is free.

name: RELEASE_ALL_LOCKS
description: Releases the connection’s named locks and returns the released acquisition count.

name: SLEEP
description: Waits for a nonnegative duration and returns zero on normal completion. NULL/invalid duration fails; cancellation/deadlines interrupt the wait.

name: BENCHMARK
description: Evaluates an expression repeatedly and returns zero after completion. NULL/negative counts return NULL; cancellation and deadlines are checked.

name: CONVERT
signature: CONVERT(value USING charset) or CONVERT(value, type)
description: Converts to supported UTF-8 charset aliases or binary bytes, or uses the supported CAST target syntax. Invalid UTF-8 and unsupported character sets fail.

name: MATCH
description: Evaluates the implemented MySQL-style FULLTEXT match and relevance score. Requires the appropriate FULLTEXT index and matching column set.
notes: Create the articles table and its FULLTEXT index before running this example. See the MySQL server guide for supported search modes.

name: CONCAT
description: Concatenates textual forms while skipping SQL NULL arguments.

name: CONCAT_WS
description: Joins non-NULL values with a separator. A NULL separator produces NULL.

name: CHAR_LENGTH
description: Counts Unicode code points in text and bytes in bytea. NULL propagates.

name: CHARACTER_LENGTH
description: Counts Unicode code points in text and bytes in bytea. NULL propagates.

name: LENGTH
description: Counts Unicode code points in text and bytes in bytea. NULL propagates.

name: OCTET_LENGTH
description: Returns bytes or eight times bytes, respectively, for text or bytea.

name: BIT_LENGTH
description: Returns bytes or eight times bytes, respectively, for text or bytea.

name: ASCII
description: Returns the first Unicode code point. An empty string returns zero.

name: CHR
description: Builds one valid Unicode character; zero and invalid Unicode code points fail.

name: STRPOS
description: Returns the one-based first occurrence or zero if absent, counting Unicode text positions.

name: POSITION
description: Returns a one-based occurrence position, or zero. Two bytea arguments use byte positions.

name: LEFT
description: Returns count characters from the requested side. A negative count excludes that many characters from the opposite side.

name: RIGHT
description: Returns count characters from the requested side. A negative count excludes that many characters from the opposite side.

name: SUBSTR
description: Returns a one-based substring. Starts before one reduce the effective covered range; a negative count fails. Text counts code points and bytea counts bytes.
notes: SUBSTRING(text, pattern) also supports the implemented regular-expression form, returning the first capture when present. General SQL regex escape syntax is unsupported.

name: SUBSTRING
description: Returns a one-based substring. Starts before one reduce the effective covered range; a negative count fails. Text counts code points and bytea counts bytes.
notes: SUBSTRING(text, pattern) also supports the implemented regular-expression form, returning the first capture when present. General SQL regex escape syntax is unsupported.

name: REPEAT
description: Repeats text; a nonpositive count returns empty. Expanded output is memory-budget checked.

name: REVERSE
description: Reverses Unicode code points.

name: INITCAP
description: Uppercases the initial alphanumeric character of each word and lowercases subsequent characters.

name: TRANSLATE
description: Maps characters by position; source characters beyond the replacement set are deleted.

name: SPLIT_PART
description: Returns a one-based split field; negative fields count from the end. Zero is invalid; absent fields return empty.

name: LPAD
description: Pads or truncates by characters. Padding defaults to a space; a nonpositive length returns empty.

name: RPAD
description: Pads or truncates by characters. Padding defaults to a space; a nonpositive length returns empty.

name: BTRIM
description: Trims a set of characters from both ends, the left end, or the right end. Default trim set is a space.

name: LTRIM
description: Trims a set of characters from both ends, the left end, or the right end. Default trim set is a space.

name: RTRIM
description: Trims a set of characters from both ends, the left end, or the right end. Default trim set is a space.

name: OVERLAY
signature: OVERLAY(text PLACING replacement FROM start [FOR count])
description: Replaces a one-based span. Omitted count uses the replacement’s character count; negative counts and nonpositive starts fail.

name: QUOTE_IDENT
description: Quotes a SQL identifier when needed and doubles embedded double quotes.

name: QUOTE_LITERAL
description: Returns an escaped SQL literal; SQL NULL returns SQL NULL.

name: QUOTE_NULLABLE
description: Returns an escaped SQL literal, or the text NULL for SQL NULL.

name: FORMAT
description: Formats with supported %s, %I, %L, positional/width forms, and literal %%. %s renders NULL as empty, %L as SQL NULL, and %I rejects NULL.

name: ENCODE
description: Encodes bytea as hex, base64, or escape text.

name: DECODE
description: Decodes hex, base64, or escape text into bytea; malformed encodings fail.

name: GET_BYTE
description: Returns a byte at a zero-based offset. Out-of-range offsets fail.

name: SET_BYTE
description: Returns a bytea copy with one byte changed. Offset is zero-based and value must be 0 through 255.

name: GET_BIT
description: Returns a bit at a zero-based offset using the implemented bytea bit numbering; out-of-range offsets fail.

name: SET_BIT
description: Returns bytea with one bit set to 0 or 1. Out-of-range offsets fail.

name: CONVERT_FROM
description: Validates UTF-8 bytes and returns text. Supported names are UTF8, UTF-8, and unicode.

name: CONVERT_TO
description: Returns UTF-8 bytes for supported UTF8, UTF-8, or unicode encoding names. Other encodings fail.

name: REGEXP_LIKE
description: Tests a RE2 pattern using supported PostgreSQL-style flags. NULL propagates.

name: REGEXP_COUNT
description: Counts matches from a one-based character position.

name: REGEXP_INSTR
signature: REGEXP_INSTR(text, pattern [, start [, occurrence [, end_option [, flags [, subexpression]]]]])
description: Returns the selected match or capture position, or zero. end_option chooses start versus end.

name: REGEXP_SUBSTR
signature: REGEXP_SUBSTR(text, pattern [, start [, occurrence [, flags [, subexpression]]]])
description: Returns a selected match/capture or NULL when absent.

name: REGEXP_REPLACE
signature: REGEXP_REPLACE(text, pattern, replacement [, flags]) or REGEXP_REPLACE(text, pattern, replacement, start [, occurrence [, flags]])
description: Replaces the first match by default; flag g or occurrence zero selects all. Supported replacement captures are expanded.
notes: RE2 cannot implement all PostgreSQL regex constructs, lookarounds, backreferences in patterns, or collating elements. Unsupported features fail explicitly.

name: JSON_BUILD_ARRAY
description: Builds JSON/JSONB arrays, preserving booleans and exact numeric values. SQL NULL elements become JSON null.

name: JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY
description: Builds JSON/JSONB arrays, preserving booleans and exact numeric values. SQL NULL elements become JSON null.

name: JSON_BUILD_OBJECT
description: Builds an object from an even number of arguments. NULL or JSON-valued object keys fail.

name: JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT
description: Builds an object from an even number of arguments. NULL or JSON-valued object keys fail.

name: TO_JSON
description: Converts an SQL value to JSON/JSONB; SQL NULL returns SQL NULL. Native boolean declarations keep JSON boolean values.

name: TO_JSONB
description: Converts an SQL value to JSON/JSONB; SQL NULL returns SQL NULL. Native boolean declarations keep JSON boolean values.

name: JSON_TYPEOF
description: Returns object, array, string, number, boolean, or null as a lowercase type label. SQL NULL stays SQL NULL.

name: JSONB_TYPEOF
description: Returns object, array, string, number, boolean, or null as a lowercase type label. SQL NULL stays SQL NULL.

name: JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH
description: Returns the array element count. A non-array input fails; NULL propagates.

name: JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH
description: Returns the array element count. A non-array input fails; NULL propagates.

name: JSON_EXTRACT_PATH
description: Traverses object keys or array indices and returns JSON/JSONB. Negative array indices count from the end. Missing paths return SQL NULL.

name: JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH
description: Traverses object keys or array indices and returns JSON/JSONB. Negative array indices count from the end. Missing paths return SQL NULL.

name: JSON_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT
description: Traverses a path and returns unquoted scalar text or serialized container text. Missing paths and JSON null return SQL NULL.

name: JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT
description: Traverses a path and returns unquoted scalar text or serialized container text. Missing paths and JSON null return SQL NULL.

name: JSONB_SET
description: Replaces a path or adds a final missing component when allowed; create_if_missing defaults to true. Path is a textual array such as {a,0}.
notes: Textual JSON paths do not provide general SQL array types. Missing intermediate components are not synthesized.

name: JSONB_INSERT
description: Inserts into an array or an absent object key. insert_after defaults to false; existing object keys cannot be replaced by this function.

name: JSONB_STRIP_NULLS
description: Recursively removes object fields whose value is JSON null; array null elements are retained.

name: JSONB_PRETTY
description: Returns the implemented indented JSONB display text.

name: ABS
description: Returns absolute numeric value. Integer and NUMERIC paths retain exact arithmetic; floating inputs retain floating representation.

name: SIGN
description: Returns numeric -1, 0, or 1.

name: CEIL
description: Rounds toward positive infinity for CEIL/CEILING, or negative infinity for FLOOR. NUMERIC paths stay exact.

name: CEILING
description: Rounds toward positive infinity for CEIL/CEILING, or negative infinity for FLOOR. NUMERIC paths stay exact.

name: FLOOR
description: Rounds toward positive infinity for CEIL/CEILING, or negative infinity for FLOOR. NUMERIC paths stay exact.

name: ROUND
description: Rounds to a decimal scale, including negative scales. NUMERIC ties round away from zero; the floating overload uses its floating-point path.

name: TRUNC
description: Truncates toward zero at the requested scale, retaining exact NUMERIC arithmetic.

name: SCALE
description: Returns the stored decimal scale of a NUMERIC value.

name: MIN_SCALE
description: Returns the minimum decimal scale after removing trailing fractional zeros.

name: TRIM_SCALE
description: Removes trailing fractional zeros from the numeric representation.

name: GCD
description: Computes greatest common divisor or least common multiple using the exact numeric implementation; supported integer inputs retain integer results.

name: LCM
description: Computes greatest common divisor or least common multiple using the exact numeric implementation; supported integer inputs retain integer results.

name: MOD
description: Returns the exact remainder. Division by zero fails.

name: DIV
description: Returns the integer quotient truncated toward zero as an exact NUMERIC value. Division by zero fails.

name: FACTORIAL
description: Returns exact factorial as NUMERIC. Negative inputs fail; work and output are bounded and cancellation is checked.

name: WIDTH_BUCKET
description: Returns a one-based equal-width bucket number. Zero and count+1 represent values beyond the bounds; reversed bounds are supported. Equal bounds or a nonpositive count fail.
notes: The array-boundaries overload is not implemented.

name: PI
description: Returns double-precision pi.

name: POW
description: Returns base raised to exponent using double precision, including NUMERIC transcendental inputs. Invalid domains and nonfinite results fail.

name: POWER
description: Returns base raised to exponent using double precision, including NUMERIC transcendental inputs. Invalid domains and nonfinite results fail.

name: LOG
description: One argument computes base-10 logarithm. Two arguments select the base. Invalid logarithm domains fail.
notes: Unlike MySQL LOG(value), this is not a natural logarithm.

name: SQRT
description: Square root. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: CBRT
description: Cube root. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: EXP
description: Base-e exponential. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: LN
description: Natural logarithm. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: LOG10
description: Base-10 logarithm. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: SIN
description: Sine, radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: COS
description: Cosine, radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: TAN
description: Tangent, radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: COT
description: Cotangent, radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ASIN
description: Inverse sine, radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ACOS
description: Inverse cosine, radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ATAN
description: Inverse tangent, radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: SINH
description: Hyperbolic sine. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: COSH
description: Hyperbolic cosine. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: TANH
description: Hyperbolic tangent. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ASINH
description: Inverse hyperbolic sine. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ACOSH
description: Inverse hyperbolic cosine. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ATANH
description: Inverse hyperbolic tangent. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: DEGREES
description: Radians to degrees. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: RADIANS
description: Degrees to radians. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: SIND
description: Sine, degrees. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: COSD
description: Cosine, degrees. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: TAND
description: Tangent, degrees. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: COTD
description: Cotangent, degrees. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ASIND
description: Inverse sine, result in degrees. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ACOSD
description: Inverse cosine, result in degrees. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ATAND
description: Inverse tangent, result in degrees. Uses double precision; NULL propagates and invalid/nonfinite results fail.

name: ATAN2
description: Returns quadrant-aware inverse tangent in radians (ATAN2) or degrees (ATAN2D).

name: ATAN2D
description: Returns quadrant-aware inverse tangent in radians (ATAN2) or degrees (ATAN2D).

name: NOW
description: Returns the transaction-start timestamp, stable across statements and savepoints within an explicit transaction. Outside a transaction it uses statement time.

name: TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP
description: Returns the transaction-start timestamp, stable across statements and savepoints within an explicit transaction. Outside a transaction it uses statement time.

name: STATEMENT_TIMESTAMP
description: Returns the current statement’s initial timestamp.

name: CLOCK_TIMESTAMP
description: Reads wall-clock time at evaluation, so it can change within one statement.

name: CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
description: Returns the transaction clock as a timestamp with timezone. Optional precision is validated and capped at microsecond precision.

name: CURRENT_DATE
description: Returns the UTC calendar date of the transaction clock.

name: CURRENT_TIME
description: Returns the transaction clock’s UTC time with timezone.

name: LOCALTIME
description: Returns the transaction clock’s UTC time without a timezone component.

name: LOCALTIMESTAMP
description: Returns the transaction clock’s UTC date-time without a timezone component.

name: TIMEOFDAY
description: Returns a wall-clock display string rather than a typed timestamp.

name: TO_TIMESTAMP
description: Converts Unix seconds to TIMESTAMPTZ or parses the supported date-template subset.

name: TO_DATE
description: Parses the implemented date-template subset to a DATE. Invalid and unsupported templates fail.

name: TO_CHAR
description: Formats the implemented temporal value/template subset. It does not implement the full PostgreSQL numeric/interval formatter.

name: DATE_PART
description: Returns a supported calendar or time component as double precision.

name: DATE_TRUNC
description: Truncates to a supported date/time unit. A timezone argument requires TIMESTAMPTZ; TIMESTAMP input retains TIMESTAMP output.

name: ISFINITE
description: Returns false for supported infinity temporal values, true for finite parsed dates/times. Invalid temporal text fails.

name: MAKE_DATE
description: Builds a valid DATE from integer components.

name: MAKE_TIME
description: Builds a TIME, including supported fractional seconds.

name: MAKE_TIMESTAMP
signature: MAKE_TIMESTAMP(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
description: Builds a TIMESTAMP without timezone from components.

name: PG_SLEEP
description: Waits for a duration and returns empty TEXT on completion. Nonpositive durations return immediately; cancellation interrupts the wait.
notes: Unlike PostgreSQL’s void result, the current engine returns TEXT. NULL input returns NULL.

name: CURRENT_DATABASE
description: Returns the database name from PostgreSQL session context.

name: CURRENT_SCHEMA
description: Returns the first existing namespace in the current search path. The native main namespace appears as public.

name: CURRENT_USER
description: Returns the user name from PostgreSQL session context.
notes: Identity labels do not provide PostgreSQL authorization or role enforcement.

name: SESSION_USER
description: Returns the user name from PostgreSQL session context.
notes: Identity labels do not provide PostgreSQL authorization or role enforcement.

name: USER
description: Returns the user name from PostgreSQL session context.
notes: Identity labels do not provide PostgreSQL authorization or role enforcement.

name: VERSION
description: Returns the server’s PostgreSQL compatibility identification string, not a separate PostgreSQL storage engine version.

name: PG_BACKEND_PID
description: Returns the backend ID supplied by the protocol session.

name: PG_CLIENT_ENCODING
description: Returns UTF8; broader client-encoding transcoding is unsupported.

name: TO_REGCLASS
description: Resolves a relation in the session’s namespace/catalog view to an OID, or NULL when absent.

name: TO_REGNAMESPACE
description: Resolves an existing namespace to its catalog OID, or NULL.

name: FORMAT_TYPE
description: Formats a supported type OID and type modifier. Unknown OIDs produce ???; supported varchar/numeric modifiers are formatted.

name: PG_TABLE_IS_VISIBLE
description: Checks relation resolution against the session’s search path. Unrecognized relation OIDs return NULL.

name: PG_GET_VIEWDEF
description: Returns stored native SQL for a known view by OID/name; unknown views return NULL. The optional pretty argument does not provide full PostgreSQL deparsing.

name: PG_GET_INDEXDEF
description: Returns implemented index SQL or a selected indexed-column expression. Supports the catalog’s synthetic primary index projection; unknown OIDs return NULL.

name: PG_GET_EXPR
description: Returns stored native SQL expression text as supplied. It does not decode PostgreSQL internal expression-node trees.

name: PG_GET_CONSTRAINTDEF
description: Returns the native SQL declaration for a known constraint, or NULL.

name: PG_GET_SERIAL_SEQUENCE
description: Currently returns NULL. SERIAL uses the native ID allocator and has no separate sequence object to name.

name: PG_ENCODING_TO_CHAR
description: Maps 6 to UTF8 and 0 to SQL_ASCII. Other IDs return an empty string.

name: PG_GET_USERBYID
description: Returns the implemented catalog/session user display label for a role OID; it does not establish ownership or privileges.

name: CURRENT_SETTING
description: Returns an implemented session/server setting. Unknown settings fail unless missing_ok is true, in which case NULL is returned.
notes: Supported keys include versions, encodings, DateStyle, TimeZone, standard_conforming_strings, integer_datetimes, isolation, search_path, and selected application settings.

name: COUNT
description: Counts all rows with star, or non-NULL expression values. Empty input returns zero.
example: SELECT COUNT(v) FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS sample;

name: SUM
description: Adds non-NULL numeric values. Empty input returns NULL. Integer sums are exact and fail on signed overflow; exact DECIMAL/unsigned inputs use exact accumulation.
example: SELECT SUM(v) FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS sample;

name: AVG
description: Averages non-NULL numeric values. Empty input returns NULL. Exact DECIMAL/unsigned inputs follow the engine’s bounded-scale decimal average path.
example: SELECT AVG(v) FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS sample;

name: MIN
description: Returns the least/greatest non-NULL value under active comparison rules; empty input returns NULL. Two or more scalar arguments select the scalar form.
example: SELECT MIN(v) FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS sample;

name: MAX
description: Returns the least/greatest non-NULL value under active comparison rules; empty input returns NULL. Two or more scalar arguments select the scalar form.
example: SELECT MAX(v) FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS sample;

name: TOTAL
description: Adds numeric values as REAL; empty input returns 0.0. Nonnumeric values and nonfinite totals fail.
example: SELECT TOTAL(v) FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS sample;

name: GROUP_CONCAT
description: Concatenates non-NULL expression values. Separator defaults to comma. Empty input returns NULL; without explicit ordering the order is not guaranteed.
example: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(v) FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS sample;
notes: MySQL also supports multiple expressions, ORDER BY, and SEPARATOR syntax. DISTINCT is normally one expression; see the MySQL guide for that extended form.

name: ROW_NUMBER
description: Assigns consecutive row numbers within each partition. Add a unique ORDER BY to make numbering deterministic among peers.
example: SELECT v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY v) AS n FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2) AS sample;

name: RANK
description: Ranks peer groups with gaps after ties. Ranking ignores the frame.
example: SELECT v, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY v) AS n FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2) AS sample;

name: DENSE_RANK
description: Ranks peer groups without gaps. Ranking ignores the frame.
example: SELECT v, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY v) AS n FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2) AS sample;

name: LAG
description: Reads a preceding/following row, default offset one. Offsets must be nonnegative int64. Missing rows use default (NULL when omitted); NULL input values are preserved. The frame is ignored.
example: SELECT v, LAG(v, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY v) AS other FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2) AS sample;

name: LEAD
description: Reads a preceding/following row, default offset one. Offsets must be nonnegative int64. Missing rows use default (NULL when omitted); NULL input values are preserved. The frame is ignored.
example: SELECT v, LEAD(v, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY v) AS other FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2) AS sample;

name: FIRST_VALUE
description: Returns the value from the first/last row of the current frame, not necessarily the full partition. An empty frame returns NULL.
example: SELECT v, FIRST_VALUE(v) OVER (ORDER BY v ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS edge FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2) AS sample;

name: LAST_VALUE
description: Returns the value from the first/last row of the current frame, not necessarily the full partition. An empty frame returns NULL.
example: SELECT v, LAST_VALUE(v) OVER (ORDER BY v ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS edge FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2) AS sample;

name: NTH_VALUE
description: Returns a one-based positive int64 position within the current frame. Returns NULL when the frame is empty or has too few rows.
example: SELECT v, NTH_VALUE(v, 2) OVER (ORDER BY v ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second FROM (SELECT 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2) AS sample;

name: FULLTEXT_MATCH
description: Returns the shared full-text relevance score using an appropriate FULLTEXT index. Index configuration, including tokenizer, normalization, stopwords, token bounds, and ranking, is persisted and reused across native, MySQL, and PostgreSQL sessions.
example: SELECT id, FULLTEXT_MATCH(body, 'slime') AS score FROM articles;
notes: Create an articles table and a FULLTEXT index on body before running this example. MySQL MATCH/AGAINST is a syntax adapter over the same engine; see SQL semantics for index configuration.

name: GET_FORMAT
description: Returns a MySQL date/time format template for DATE, TIME, DATETIME, or TIMESTAMP. Format families are USA, JIS, ISO, EUR, and INTERNAL. Unknown families return NULL; an invalid temporal type fails.

name: CONVERT_TZ
description: Converts a civil date-time between UTC/GMT, supported fixed offsets, or available IANA time zones, including daylight-saving changes. Unknown zones and invalid inputs return NULL.
notes: Named zones use the host time-zone database. Values outside the supported Unix conversion range retain their original civil value.

name: JSON_SEARCH
description: Searches JSON string values with LIKE-style percent/underscore wildcards. Returns one matching path, a JSON array of paths, or SQL NULL when no value matches. Optional paths restrict the search roots.
notes: Modes are one and all. Escape defaults to backslash and must be empty or one character when supplied; a NULL escape retains the default. The document, mode, and search pattern propagate SQL NULL.

name: NAME_CONST
description: Returns a literal value with its value type. Arguments must be literals or signed literal forms, and the name must not be NULL. Expressions, subqueries, and column references fail.
notes: Available in MySQL dialect; this does not substitute SQL or create a persistent variable.

name: STARTS_WITH
description: Returns whether text begins with the prefix using literal case-sensitive matching. NULL arguments return NULL.

name: TO_HEX
description: Formats an integer as lowercase hexadecimal. Negative INTEGER inputs use 32-bit two’s-complement width; BIGINT inputs use 64-bit width. NULL returns NULL.

name: BIT_COUNT
description: Counts set bits in all bytes of a BYTEA value. This PostgreSQL overload takes BYTEA rather than the MySQL integer form. NULL returns NULL.

name: SHA224
description: Returns the named SHA-2 digest of a BYTEA input as raw bytes. NULL returns NULL. Use ENCODE for a hexadecimal display.
notes: MySQL SHA2 returns hexadecimal TEXT and selects the digest width with a separate numeric argument.

name: SHA256
description: Returns the named SHA-2 digest of a BYTEA input as raw bytes. NULL returns NULL. Use ENCODE for a hexadecimal display.
notes: MySQL SHA2 returns hexadecimal TEXT and selects the digest width with a separate numeric argument.

name: SHA384
description: Returns the named SHA-2 digest of a BYTEA input as raw bytes. NULL returns NULL. Use ENCODE for a hexadecimal display.
notes: MySQL SHA2 returns hexadecimal TEXT and selects the digest width with a separate numeric argument.

name: SHA512
description: Returns the named SHA-2 digest of a BYTEA input as raw bytes. NULL returns NULL. Use ENCODE for a hexadecimal display.
notes: MySQL SHA2 returns hexadecimal TEXT and selects the digest width with a separate numeric argument.

name: NORMALIZE
description: Returns Unicode-normalized text. Forms are NFC (default), NFD, NFKC, and NFKD. NULL arguments return NULL; invalid forms fail.
notes: NORMALIZE also accepts the supported unquoted normalization-form syntax. Expanded output is checked against the query memory budget.

name: IS_NORMALIZED
description: Tests whether text is already in the requested NFC (default), NFD, NFKC, or NFKD form. NULL arguments return NULL; invalid forms fail.

name: UNISTR
description: Decodes supported Unicode escapes: four-digit forms, u-prefixed four digits, plus-prefixed six digits, and U-prefixed eight digits. Surrogate pairs are combined; invalid pairs, zero, and invalid code points fail.
notes: A doubled backslash represents a literal backslash. PostgreSQL string syntax retains the escapes for this function to process.

name: NUM_NULLS
description: Counts SQL NULL arguments (NUM_NULLS) or non-NULL arguments (NUM_NONNULLS). At least one argument is required; SQL NULLs are counted rather than propagated.

name: NUM_NONNULLS
description: Counts SQL NULL arguments (NUM_NULLS) or non-NULL arguments (NUM_NONNULLS). At least one argument is required; SQL NULLs are counted rather than propagated.

name: GEN_RANDOM_UUID
description: Generates a cryptographically random version-4 UUID and returns a typed UUID value. Calls are volatile.

name: JSON_STRIP_NULLS
description: Recursively removes JSON object fields with JSON null values. Array null elements are retained. SQL NULL returns SQL NULL.
notes: This is the JSON counterpart of JSONB_STRIP_NULLS; the optional strip-array-nulls extension is not implemented.

name: JSONB_SET_LAX
description: Updates JSONB like JSONB_SET when the replacement is non-NULL. For SQL NULL replacements, the supported treatments are use_json_null (default), delete_key, return_target, and raise_exception.
notes: create_if_missing defaults to true. SQL NULL target, path, or explicit creation flag returns SQL NULL. A NULL treatment is invalid. Paths use textual array notation and do not provide general SQL arrays.
